'''Crawler Cavern''' was a cave in a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] desert inhabited by a number of dangerous [[Sand Slug]]s.<ref name="NP article">{{StoryCite|story=Star Wars (article)|book=Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|bformatted=''Nintendo Power'' Vol. 28|sformatted=''Star Wars''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name of the cave comes from a guide to the [[1991]] [[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game]] in ''Nintendo Power'' magazine.<ref name="NP article" /> The ''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]'' game guide refers to it as "Green Cave East."<ref name="Hint Book">''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''</ref>
